phase: Phase 9: Release proof and print order (2026-11-19 to 2026-11-25)
summary: The batch is implementable as written: the C2 table values pass a repeated ink measure (all 32 at or above 0.02 em), the F3 list matches the English D4 lines of weeks 2 to 7, the 20 picture rows and texts of P9-B10 verify against pictures.json and the decodable pages, the page arithmetic of P9-B8 holds, and the pin hits are covered. One open Major: the review-page pairs are sentences, not the single words of Daniel's order (Q9-9). It needs Daniel. Three Nits: the day-5 week scope, the C2-book absolute positions, and the RM-decodable names and ratio scope.

paraphrase.proposes: The batch fixes C2 (the trace start table gains 8 missing lowercase letters and new positions for c, d, g, and S, guarded by a new ink test on all 32 values), fixes F3 (the D4 teacher script order of weeks 2 to 7 matches the writing-page order; 14 Thai lines change, 10 move), and adds 4 week-8 review pages, one after each of days 2 to 5, so the student book goes from 136 to 140 pages. It also updates the w08 scripts, the step map, and the teacher book, ships proof r6-v3 with a cast sheet, and holds all Thai drafts to Daniel's check. C2 and F3 start only on Daniel's FIX answer at the r6-v2 proof look; the review pages need no answer.
paraphrase.current_system: The student book compiles to 136 pages from the week files and the print code. Trace start dots come from TRACE_START_EM (18 lowercase and 6 uppercase values) with no ink-based test, and a word that starts with a missing letter throws. The D4 step of weeks 2 to 7 names the trace before the page's prompt action, so the script order differs from the page order. Week 8 has five review pages on pages 132 to 136 and no app package; the step map and the teacher book take their page references from the compiled book.

nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] spec.md Q9-9 and P9-B10 (review-page content): The 16 match pairs are short decodable sentences, where Daniel's order says "read the words and match them to pictures". Rationale: the repo holds single-word object pictures for ant, pot, and mop only (verified: l2-w02-check-row-ant, l2-w07-card-pot, l2-w07-card-mop in pictures.json), and the order forbids new generation, so sentences are the only compliant reading; still the pupil task differs from the ordered one and Daniel decides. Default: keep sentences (the Q9-9 default); Daniel answers at the r6-v2 proof look; a single-word choice needs new picture generation or a changed order.

F2 [Nit] spec.md P9-B10 (day 5 weeks): Day 5 pairs and sentence come from weeks 2, 3, 4, 5, and 7, not from "mixed weeks 1-7" of the order; the week-1 reason is recorded, the week-6 reason is not. Rationale: the week-1 exclusion is documented and true (the w01 decodable is an exempt sound book, and "Nan can nod!" has the untaught letter d); the week-6 exclusion has no stated reason. Default: keep the P9-B10 content and add one line that day 3 already reviews week 6.

F3 [Nit] spec.md P9-B5 (C2-mutants (b) and C2-book): The left-middle mutant (x 0.1, y 0.25) sits on glyph ink for c and d (re-measured 0.039 em and 0.042 em), so C2-ink catches the combined mutant only through s (re-measured 0.000 em, on white). Rationale: fact 5 records that today's book tests compare a dot with the table that placed it, so a table-relative C2-book cannot catch a partial left-middle mutant of c or d. Default: C2-book asserts the absolute measured dot positions of fact 2 (car, kite, drum, can, see, saw) within 0.3 mm.

F4 [Nit] spec.md P9-B13 (RM-decodable): The per-text decodability assertion must receive the names of the source reader and must not assert the 0.9 ratio per text. Rationale: checks.ts excepts names from untaught words (the w06 decodable lists names ["Pip"]), and "Pip sat on the mat!" alone is 4 of 5 decodable (0.8), so a per-text ratio assertion fails the page's own data; the book-level E2 check computes the ratio over the whole book. Default: assert untaught.length === 0 with names passed; no per-text ratio.
